declarations.name: ShowfmPlayer
declarations.description: The show.fm podcast player. Set `episode` to play one episode, or `podcast` to play the latest one.

attributes.name: episode
attributes.description: Episode UUID. Plays that one episode and wins over `podcast`.

attributes.name: podcast
attributes.description: Podcast slug or UUID. Plays the latest released episode.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Pins the theme. Absent follows the show's player theme setting.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Player size. The height contract depends on it.

attributes.name: accent
attributes.description: Accent colour as a hex value. Absent follows the show's player colour.

attributes.name: wave
attributes.description: Pins the waveform on or off. Absent follows the show's waveform setting.

attributes.name: api
attributes.description: API origin override, for development and testing only.

attributes.name: heading-level
attributes.description: Wraps the episode title in a heading of this level. Absent, the title is a link and no heading is emitted.

attributes.name: credit
attributes.description: The "Powered by show.fm" footer. `auto` and `off` hide it only when the show's plan includes branding removal and the show has turned it off (the API's `branding.show_powered_by` is false); with no payload it shows. `on` always shows it. With `platform="wordpress"`, `off` hides it for any show. It shows once per page, on the first embed that shows it.

attributes.name: load
attributes.description: `click` draws a facade and requests nothing from show.fm until the visitor presses it. `showfm.load()` loads every facade at once.

attributes.name: transcript
attributes.description: `on` adds a Transcript button that opens the follow-along transcript under the player, which grows downwards; `open` opens it at once. `reader` makes the button open a full-screen reader instead: a modal dialog with the player pinned on top, search, and speakers' photos. Only the standard size has the button, and only when the audio and the transcript are on show.fm. Absent, there is no button.

attributes.name: speaker-photos
attributes.description: The reader (`transcript="reader"`) shows each speaker's photo from the episode's credits beside their lines. `off` shows their initials instead, as for a speaker with no photo.

attributes.name: strings
attributes.description: Overrides for visible strings, by key, usually set as a property. `window.showfmStrings` sets them for every element.

attributes.name: mini-player
attributes.description: `on`: when the visitor scrolls the player out of view while it plays, the page's mini-player takes over its audio, so playback carries on with seek, skip, speed and the time left. Off by default.

attributes.name: mini-player-position
attributes.description: The corner the collapsed mini-player sits in, when this element opens it. `--showfm-bottom-offset` lifts it.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: For the show.fm WordPress plugin only, which passes `credit="off"` unless the site owner opts in: a credit in plugin code must be opt-in (WordPress.org guideline 10). With it, `credit="off"` hides "Powered by show.fm" for any show. Other sites should not set it.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-accent
cssProperties.description: The accent, one colour in. The fill (3:1 on the card and the tint), text in the accent (4.5:1), the colour on the fill, the tint and the glow are derived from it for light and dark. A pinned `accent` attribute wins over it; it wins over the show's colour.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-accent-text
cssProperties.description: Text and links in the accent. Darkened or lightened until it reaches 4.5:1 on the card, the tint and the controls.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-surface
cssProperties.description: The card background. The text colours are derived from it: it decides between dark and light text, whatever `theme` says. A mid-tone is lightened or darkened until text can reach 7:1 on it.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-text
cssProperties.description: Titles and body text. Adjusted until it reaches 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-muted
cssProperties.description: Secondary text: dates, times, "Powered by". Adjusted until it reaches 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-border
cssProperties.description: Card borders and dividers. Decorative, so it is used as written.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-wave
cssProperties.description: The unplayed waveform bars. Decorative, so it is used as written.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-wave-played
cssProperties.description: The played part of the waveform. Adjusted until it reaches 3:1 on the card and on the tint of a playing row.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-focus
cssProperties.description: The keyboard focus ring. Adjusted until it reaches 3:1 on the card, the tint and the controls.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-font
cssProperties.description: The font. Unset, every element uses the page's font. No font is ever downloaded; the player's heights hold in any font.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-font-title
cssProperties.description: Episode titles only.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-radius
cssProperties.description: Corners of the cards, held to 0 to 28px. Artwork follows at 70%. Play buttons and pills stay round; on a play button it rounds the phone mini-player's bar and sheet.

cssParts.name: error
cssParts.description: The card shown when the episode cannot be played.

declarations.name: ShowfmEpisodes
declarations.description: A podcast's episodes as a list or grid, each one playable. The list's code loads the first time one is on the page. Its fallback is a list of title links (renderEpisodeListHTML), which shows until the list mounts and without JavaScript. Set --showfm-height to the height to reserve; the list keeps it as its minimum and grows downwards only.

attributes.name: podcast
attributes.description: Podcast UUID (preferred, it survives a slug change) or slug.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Card shows artwork and descriptions; Minimal is a quieter text list.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: `auto` is a grid from 900px wide (for Card, when at least half the episodes have their own artwork), else a list. A grid under 480px wide shows as a list.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Episodes per page, 1 to 50. "Load more" fetches the next page.

attributes.name: season
attributes.description: Only this season.

attributes.name: hide
attributes.description: Episode types to leave out: `trailer`, `bonus` or `trailer,bonus`.

attributes.name: descriptions
attributes.description: Episode descriptions, two lines with "More" in the list layout.

attributes.name: mini-player

declarations.name: ShowfmPlay
declarations.description: A play button for one episode, as an icon, a labelled button or a link in a sentence. Every button on the page plays through the same page audio, and the first play opens the page's mini-player (a bar along the bottom of the window, a pill when collapsed, a sheet on phones) unless `mini-player` is `off`. Its code loads the first time one is on the page. Its fallback is a title link and a plain audio control (renderEpisodeHTML), which shows until the button mounts and without JavaScript.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: `sm` keeps a 40px line. `lg` is 48px (label) or 56px (icon). The link takes the text around it.

attributes.name: mini-player
attributes.description: `on`: the first play opens the page's mini-player, with seek, skip, speed and the time left. `off`: visitors can only play and pause, and the button shows "Powered by show.fm" itself when the page's credit falls to it.

declarations.name: ShowfmTranscript
declarations.description: The follow-along transcript: the line being spoken is highlighted (word by word when the transcript has word timings), a click on a line seeks, and the visitor can search it. It follows the episode in `episode`, the player or list named by `for`, or else whatever plays on the page. Its code loads the first time one is on the page. Its fallback is the transcript as paragraphs (renderTranscriptHTML), for search engines and visitors without JavaScript. Set --showfm-height to the height to reserve.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: The id of a `showfm-player` or `showfm-episodes` on the page: the transcript follows what it plays.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height of the text area in pixels, 120 to 2000. The search row adds 55px, and the border 2px.

cssProperties.description: The accent, one colour in. The fill (3:1 on the card and the tint), text in the accent (4.5:1), the colour on the fill, the tint and the glow are derived from it for light and dark. A pinned `accent` attribute wins over it; it wins over the show's colour.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-accent-text
cssProperties.description: Text and links in the accent. Darkened or lightened until it reaches 4.5:1 on the card, the tint and the controls.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-surface
cssProperties.description: The card background. The text colours are derived from it: it decides between dark and light text, whatever `theme` says. A mid-tone is lightened or darkened until text can reach 7:1 on it.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-text
cssProperties.description: Titles and body text. Adjusted until it reaches 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-muted
cssProperties.description: Secondary text: dates, times, "Powered by". Adjusted until it reaches 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-border
cssProperties.description: Card borders and dividers. Decorative, so it is used as written.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-focus
cssProperties.description: The keyboard focus ring. Adjusted until it reaches 3:1 on the card, the tint and the controls.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-font
cssProperties.description: The font. Unset, every element uses the page's font. No font is ever downloaded; the player's heights hold in any font.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-font-scale
cssProperties.description: Scales the list's type and the transcript's lines, 0.85 to 1.3. The player, the play button and the mini-player keep their sizes, which their fixed heights need.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-radius
cssProperties.description: Corners of the cards, held to 0 to 28px. Artwork follows at 70%. Play buttons and pills stay round; on a play button it rounds the phone mini-player's bar and sheet.

cssProperties.name: --showfm-height
cssProperties.description: The height to reserve before the element loads. A list keeps it as its minimum height; a transcript's fallback text scrolls inside it.
